dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: Would you like some tea? Come, sit, sit. These meteorites have really gotten everyone worked up. The number of people who come here to chat have grown fewer in number.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: Here for some tea? Please take a seat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your tea store.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: I set up shop here to provide some respite from the grueling and relentless farm work, both for old friends and for anyone else passing by.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: But as you can see, business could be a little better, hehehe.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: Still. Every time someone comes to me for a cup of tea and a chat, I think to myself, this is worth my while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you run the place on your own?

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: That's right. My son and his wife are off elsewhere, chasing their dreams. It's just the grandkids and I who are left in the village.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I had an assistant, I could keep the place open while I was working in the fields.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: Leaving so soon? Have a safe trip.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you have to sell, sir?

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: Please have a seat and stay for a while. You can try some of our very own Qingce Village tea.
